no_accounts_with_role: No Accounts with this role yet.
empty_body: Ballast needs to know where your money lives. Add each Account and say what it's for.
open_account_description: Name it and say what it's for.
problem_name_too_long: Name must be at most 100 characters
role_operating_cash_description: Day-to-day money for bills and other Expenses.
role_reserve_description: Your safety reserve. Counts towards the Reserve Target.
role_investment_description: Money invested for the long term.
role_liability_description: Debt you owe, such as cards and loans.
theme_description: Follow your device, or always use light or dark.
language_description: Ballast follows your browser's language until you choose one.
add_transaction_description: Record money that moved outside an Import, such as cash.
edit_transaction_description: Change or delete this manual Transaction.
no_transactions_body: Add money in or out by hand. Imports from your bank arrive in a later release.
problem_amount_invalid: Use digits with up to two decimals, e.g. 12.34
problem_direction_required: Choose money in or money out
problem_description_too_long: Description must be at most 200 characters
transaction_already_deleted: This Transaction had already been deleted, so there was nothing to change.
interest_rate_hint: Optional. Ballast uses it to spot High-Interest Debt.
problem_interest_rate_invalid: Enter a rate from 0 to 100% with up to two decimals, e.g. 18.5
edit_account_description: Change its name or what it's for.
archive_account_hint: Closed it? Archiving keeps its history but leaves it out of your Accounts and of Recommendations.
account_archived_notice: This Account is archived. Its history stays, but it no longer counts in your Accounts or in Recommendations.
no_active_accounts: Every Account is archived. Open one, or unarchive one below.
problem_role_has_holdings: Remove its Holdings before it stops being an Investment
investment_holdings_hint: You record its Holdings on the Account's page. Ballast works out the asset-class mix from what each one is worth.
add_holding_description: Record a fund, stock or other investment in this Account and what it's worth now.
edit_holding_description: Update what it's worth, or change or remove it.
holding_kind_index_fund_description: Tracks an Index, such as MSCI World
holding_kind_other_description: Active funds, single bonds, crypto and the rest
holding_ticker_hint: Optional. Kept so prices can be fetched automatically later.
holding_stock_is_equity: A stock always counts as Equity.
holding_units_hint: Optional. How many shares or units you hold.
holding_already_removed: This Holding had already been removed, so there was nothing to change.
no_holdings_body: Add the funds, stocks and other investments in this Account. Ballast works out its asset-class mix from what each one is worth.
investments_overview_hint: Asset-class mix, Indexes and stocks across your Investment Accounts
concentrated_stock: {name} is {share} of your Investment, above the {limit} Concentration Limit.
concentrated_advice: Mainstream guidance spreads money across many companies, for example through index funds.
no_investments_body: Add Holdings to your Investment Accounts to see where your money is.
problem_ticker_invalid: Use up to 20 letters, digits, dots, colons or dashes, e.g. VWCE
problem_index_too_long: The Index must be at most 100 characters
problem_units_invalid: Use digits with up to 8 decimals, e.g. 12.5
problem_units_zero: Units can't be zero. Leave it blank if you don't know.
holding_name_optional_hint: Optional for an index fund. Leave it blank to call it by its Index.
asset_class_equity_in_index_fund: Tracks an index of shares, e.g. MSCI World
asset_class_bonds_in_index_fund: Tracks an index of bonds, e.g. euro government bonds
asset_class_cash_in_index_fund: Tracks a short-term interest rate, e.g. €STR
asset_class_crypto_in_index_fund: Tracks an index of crypto-assets, e.g. a crypto basket ETP
asset_class_other_in_index_fund: Tracks a commodity or real-estate index, e.g. Bloomberg Commodity
asset_class_equity_in_other: An actively managed fund of shares
asset_class_bonds_in_other: A single bond, or an actively managed bond fund
asset_class_cash_in_other: Uninvested cash or a money-market fund
asset_class_other_in_other: Gold, real estate and the rest
no_investment_transactions_body: Record money you put in or took out: contributions, withdrawals, dividends paid in cash and fees.
add_transaction_description_reserve: Record a deposit or withdrawal that didn't come from an Import.
add_transaction_description_investment: Record a contribution, withdrawal, cash dividend or fee.
add_transaction_description_liability: Record a charge, such as a purchase or interest, or a payment towards what you owe.
no_transactions_body_liability: Add charges and payments by hand. Imports from your bank arrive in a later release.
transaction_example_reserve_outflow: e.g. Withdrawal for a car repair
